notes.title: "Changdong's Bikini Adventure" 1.2 update infomation
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735243/a830af5f9f3bed3da51812a254446d3619c5f648.png[/img]
Hello, this is Changdong Software.

Changdong's Bikini Adventure 1.2 update is complete.
The update includes the following changes:

[b]New Shop in the Town?[/b]
A new major establishment has appeared. You can borrow from 1000 coins to 10,000 coins.

[b]Town Pub Related[/b]
Gold potions have been added. (When purchased, they can increase the coins dropped by monsters)

[b]System Related[/b]
If you collect 100 map pieces, you can choose not to see the scene of moving to the Devil's Castle for a certain number of turns.
Resolved the issue of obtaining the Fallen Angel's Wings challenge even when the conditions are not met.
Changdong is now susceptible to confusion as a new status condition.

[b]Illustration Related[/b]
Characters are wearing Santa hats. (Limited until January 1st)

[b]Monster Related[/b]
Tuna and meerkat have been added.
The coins dropped by monsters has been increased.

[b]Other[/b]
Fixed a few typos.

Please continue to love Changdong in the future.

notes.title: Changdong's Bikini Adventure 1.1 Update Released!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735243/f863b9c703cee85231023b306e36503170a01c95.png[/img]
Hello, this is Changdong Software.
Changdong's Bikini Adventure 1.1 update is now complete, and here are the changes included in the update:

[b][Item-related][/b]
Digestive Aid: (When used, eliminates nausea from meal consumption for a random number of times.)
Evian: (When used, eliminates failures of all probability-based skills, including meal consumption, for a random number of times.)
Sek: (When used, eliminates monster attack turns for a random number of times.)

[b][Town Pub-related][/b]
Divine Blessing has been added: (When purchased, it guarantees a 100% success rate for food consumed at the pub.)

[b][Sound related][/b]
The game now features various sound effects such as impact sounds and button sounds! Now you can enjoy an even more immersive gaming experience.

[b][System-related][/b]
Items not owned by the player will not be displayed when using items.
The shop randomly selects and sells items among Park Chunjam and three other items.
Town shop sells all items on a page-by-page basis.
Success conditions for challenges have been changed.
Bug fix: Credits are now displayed after the happy ending.

[b][Illustration-related][/b]
Added illustrations for Corrupted Angel Wings, Lettuce Sword, Garlic Repair Sword, Corrupted Angel Wings, and Evian.
Some English illustrations have been added.

[b][Monster-related][/b]
Adjusted monster attack power.

[b][Other][/b]
Corrected a few typos.
Please continue to show lots of love for Changdong in the future.

notes.title: About the official release of the game
notes.content:
[b]Changdong's Bikini Adventure is officially released![/b]
Changdong's Bikini Adventure, a high school graduation work, has finally been officially released after a long period of consideration. Thank you for your patience.
- You will be given a 15% discount for a week after launch
- There are more types of monsters than the trial version (more to be added later)
- Various functions will be added in the future (store item addition)
